sloka: इत्युक्त्वोत्थाय तं क्षिप्रं बाहुभ्यामाक्षिपत्तले ।कन्दुवत्स समुत्थाय बाहुभ्यामाक्षिपद्धरिः ।। ६-४०-१३।।
transliteration: ityuktvotthāya taṁ kṣipraṁ bāhubhyāmākṣipattale ।kanduvatsa samutthāya bāhubhyāmākṣipaddhariḥ ।। 6-40-13।।

translations.english: Telling like that that Ravana got up and threw Sugriva by his hand s to the ground. Then Sugriva getting up like a ball fallen pushed Ravana down.
